clips.title: The story
paras: In Westfall, Old Blanchy needs oats after the Furlbrows' wagon breaks down.

Westfall once fed the Kingdom of Stormwind, but its farms now lie overgrown or under the control of Defias bandits and rogue harvest golems. Sacks of grain and oats remain near barns, outbuildings, and overgrown fields. Travelers and refugees stranded by broken wagons along the dusty roads can gather the leftover oats to feed their weary draft horses.
